description: Only for the Ania owner account (admin): the videos the internal factory made for the owner’s YouTube channels, newest first, with state, version, QA summary, preview link and the owner’s past reason/comment. Default filtro "ver" = ready and waiting for the owner’s OK. Show them to the user and ask approve/reject, then call studio_decidir_video. Free.
